source_type: Credible financial journalism reporting on RBI regulatory action and official RBI press release/directions

contamination_notes: Later licence cancellation proceedings, FEMA/ED enforcement notices, final business impact statements (revenue, market share), later recovery or settlement plans, and post-outcome market reactions must not appear in input.json. Later licence cancellation, FEMA/ED actions, and final business impact remain in outcome only
